amp> thedog = <t -> h -> e -> d -> o -> g>
thedog: <t, h, e, d, o, g> and transition t -> h -> e -> d -> o -> g
amp> thecat = <t -> h -> e -> c -> a -> t>
thecat: <t, h, e, c, a, t> and transition t -> h -> e -> c -> a -> t
amp> themouse = <t -> h -> e -> m -> o -> u -> s -> e>
themouse: <t, h, e, m, o, u, s, e> and transition t -> h -> e -> m -> o -> u -> s -> e
amp> the = intr thedog, thecat, themouse
the: intersection t, h, e, as <thedog{t, h, e}> and transition thedog{t, h, e}
amp> dog = difference thedog, the
dog: difference d, o, g, as <thedog{d, o, g}> and transition thedog{d, o, g}
amp> insp dog

amp> cat = diff thecat, the

amp> x = diff the, thedog
